edits.title: Web MIDI project: JSON dataset of electronic drum kits (manufacturer, model, versions, MIDI mappings) for kit recognition (as of Dec 2023)
edits.content: On 2023-12-17 the user asked for the default MIDI mappings of popular electronic drums for a project to recognize electronic drum kits in Web MIDI ('I would like to recognize them in web midi'). They want the kit data in a common JSON format with fields: manufacturer, model name, and possible versions, and asked to add MIDI mappings to the same JSON ('This looks good but add midi mapping, too'). They chose to organize the dataset manufacturer by manufacturer, starting with the top 5 Roland kits, then continuing to Yamaha, Alesis, and 2box. The mapping fields cover standard drum pieces (kick, snare, hi-hat closed/open, tom 1–3, crash cymbal, ride cymbal). Specific MIDI note numbers and version lists shown in the conversation were assistant-generated and not independently verified by the user or tools.
edits.reason: Records the user's Web MIDI drum-kit recognition project and its required JSON schema so later sessions can continue the dataset work consistently; excludes unverified assistant-supplied note values.

proposal.expectedOutcome: Future work on this project can resume with the correct schema (manufacturer, model, versions, midi_mappings per kit, grouped by manufacturer, Roland first) without re-deriving requirements; validate by checking that follow-up drum-kit or Web MIDI requests reuse this field structure and manufacturer ordering.
